description: Product-independent variation applied inside every generated market-role child. It changes attention and interpretation, never need, fit, authority, budget, timing, or product capabilities.

human_microprofiles.attention: Phone feed is silent and the thumb is moving; meaning delayed beyond two seconds is usually lost.
human_microprofiles.language: Accepts one literal problem statement and ignores slogans or stacked claims.
human_microprofiles.evidence: One immediately legible causal change can extend attention.

human_microprofiles.attention: Will read concise relevant copy but leaves when wording feels generated or overproduced.
human_microprofiles.language: Rejects generic polish, false intimacy, vague transformations, symmetrical lists, and marketing superlatives.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Trusts concrete operator detail, disclosed limits, and ordinary language.

human_microprofiles.attention: Allows roughly six seconds only when the current job appears immediately.
human_microprofiles.language: Wants ordinary verbs, one claim, and no marketing setup.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Prefers one useful mechanism over testimonials or broad outcomes.

human_microprofiles.attention: Will watch longer when a real mechanism begins immediately and every scene advances it.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Tracks input, action, and resulting state; unexplained jumps break belief.

human_microprofiles.attention: Scans for price, commitment, cancellation, and the exact next step before investing further attention.
human_microprofiles.language: Rewards direct disclosure and rejects euphemistic offer language.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Needs enough factual value to compare price and setup effort with the current alternative.

human_microprofiles.attention: Stays for a short story only when role, situation, and constraints resemble their own.
human_microprofiles.language: Accepts natural speech but dislikes polished testimonial scripts.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Wants before, mechanism, after, and a disclosed limitation.

human_microprofiles.attention: An outcome can earn a glance, but testimonial emphasis without inspectable mechanism loses attention.
human_microprofiles.language: Treats attributed quotes as advertising claims until corroborated.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Requires visible product behavior and does not infer representativeness from one customer.

human_microprofiles.attention: Views silently on a small screen and stays only while text and state changes remain sparse and legible.
human_microprofiles.language: Short labels work; paragraphs and dense interface text disappear.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Prefers one zoomed workflow over several feature cuts.

human_microprofiles.attention: Can read longer relevant copy but abandons repetition.
human_microprofiles.language: Values exact limits, setup, fit, and offer details and notices contradictions.
human_microprofiles.evidence: Compares stated facts with the current alternative and records unanswered questions.

human_microprofiles.attention: Exposure is incidental and discontinuous; at most one concrete idea is retained.
human_microprofiles.language: Copy style matters little without unusually strong situational relevance.
human_microprofiles.evidence: A click is possible, but later commitment requires deliberate research.
